authority: Iowa Natural Resource Commission and Iowa Legislature

review.reviewMethod: Complete pdfplumber text extraction and visual review of both pages, with taxon-level identities for the two-species purple-loosestrife row.

incompleteDependencies.reason: The rule incorporates exact federal lists as amended to June 17, 2026. Existing federal artifacts cannot be assumed to represent that precise cutoff without separate version verification.

contradictions.subject: row-count-versus-taxon-count
contradictions.priorState: The explicit rule display contains nineteen common-name rows.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The purple-loosestrife row names two scientific taxa, so the nineteen rows contain twenty taxon strings.
contradictions.resolution: Both taxon strings are preserved under unique deterministic source-record identities linked to the same legal row. Thirteen exact catalog taxa are accepted and seven remain blocked.

contradictions.subject: incorporated-federal-lists
contradictions.priorState: Chapter 571.90.2 incorporates federal aquatic noxious-weed and injurious-wildlife lists.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The rule fixes those dependencies as amended to June 17, 2026, while the repository's retained federal acquisitions do not yet prove exact parity to both cutoff lists.
contradictions.resolution: Only the nineteen explicit Iowa rows were processed. Both incorporated federal dependencies remain explicit certification gaps, and no broad reacquisition or unsupported completion claim was made.

contradictions.subject: infested-waters-language
contradictions.priorState: The chapter authorizes Iowa DNR to designate infested waters and discusses species distribution.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The retained chapter does not itself enumerate current county-equivalent occurrences, a complete survey, or negative results.
contradictions.resolution: The review creates state regulatory applicability only. It creates no county occurrence, absence, not-detected, or not-applicable evidence.

contradictions.subject: initial-source-record-collision
contradictions.priorState: The first generated review assigned one source-record ID to both scientific taxa on the purple-loosestrife row.
contradictions.currentEvidence: Central validation rejected the review before any shared applicability write because source-record IDs must be unique.
contradictions.resolution: The generator now includes a deterministic taxon suffix. The corrected replay has zero duplicate source-record IDs and the failed first merge changed no shared applicability output.
